title: Anti-drone technology fails at PSEG Salem/Hope Creek
place_text: Hope Creek Generating Station, Salem County, New Jersey

tellings.quote: they tried to deploy an anti-drone technology over multiple drones that were seen over the nuclear site and that anti- drone Dr technology which normally works on all drones completely failed

plain: In 2024, staff at the Salem and Hope Creek nuclear power plants in Salem County, New Jersey, run by the power company PSEG, are said to have aimed anti-drone equipment at several drones flying over the site, and the equipment, which normally works on any drone, failed completely. Robert Hastings, a researcher who has long collected reports of UFOs at nuclear sites, relays this from an unnamed person with access to the plant's internal messages. If true, the objects were something ordinary drone defences could not touch.
